name: attention-list
title: Attention list
description: What needs a person right now: severity in a shape and a word, the time and one action per row, a dismissal you can undo, or a calm all-clear.
docs: Mount one Toaster (the toast item) once in your app: dismissing a row shows an Undo toast through it. Drop the item from `items` in `onDismiss` and put it back in `onUndoDismiss`.
